mechanism: Prochlorperazine may inhibit CYP3A4 and CYP2D6, potentially increasing anastrozole plasma concentrations, while both drugs carry independent risks of QT prolongation and adverse CNS effects.
action: Monitor for increased anastrozole side effects (hot flashes, joint pain, headache); baseline ECG recommended given QT prolongation potential; use lowest effective prochlorperazine dose for nausea/vomiting management.
